Subject: Tenant TLK rekey playbook + FIPS attestation (Novus onboarding)

Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Novus is moving toward a staged onboarding and our security review needs a compact set of artifacts specific to tenant-level keying (our "TLK" usage). To keep the SOC2/SIG review focused, can you provide the following by end of day next Tuesday (Dec 10)? If any items need longer, please flag with ETA.

Requested items (concise):
- FIPS 140-3 attestation / validation summary for the HSM(s) used to wrap TLKs (vendor-signed PDF).
- Operator access list and separation-of-duties mapping for HSM key custodians (CSV).
- Tenant TLK rotation schedule and example rotation trace (timestamps, key-id mapping, and who initiated).
- Evidence of entropy source / DRBG tests used for TLK generation (test vectors or report).
- Sample transit cipher negotiation policy (TLS ciphers, min version) and any explicit TLS termination points for key material flows.
- A short playbook for an emergency TLK rekey (steps, leads, rollback).

Also, Novus requires a short statement if any of these artifacts contain customer-identifiable information and how you'll redact it. We can accept redacted artifacts plus an index file that lists what was redacted.

If it helps, we can take the first cut and then schedule a 30-min call to walk through artifacts.

Best,
Alice
Alice Turner
Senior Information Security Manager
Novus Bank

---
Attachment hints: we prefer vendor-signed PDFs, CSV operator mapping, and .log samples for rotation traces.

Karthik / Marissa — please treat Novus as high priority for artifacts requested by Alice. Summary of asks and minimal acceptance criteria: 

Karthik (HSM + operator):
- Provide the vendor-signed FIPS 140-3 attestation PDF if available; if vendor signatures require procurement steps, provide a signed "validation summary" now + vendor ETA for signed PDF.
- Export HSM operator ACL as CSV: columns: operator_id, role, start_date, end_date (if temporary), 2FA method, last_mfa_rotation. Include mapping to Redwood employee IDs.
- Add a one-paragraph note on whether HSM key wrapping uses a split-guard ceremony and the custody model.

Marissa (rotation + playbook):
- Tenant TLK rotation schedule (CSV) plus a sampled rotation trace (rotation-trace-sample.log) showing key-id, old-key-id, new-key-id, timestamp UTC, initiating-principal. Redact tenant ids; replace with pseudonyms (tenant-1234).
- Emergency TLK rekey playbook as a markdown doc (rekey-playbook-novus.md) with action list, contacts, rollback criteria, and estimated RTO.
- Entropy/DRBG report: include test vector outputs or vendor report (entropy-source-report.txt).

Also: include a short transit-cipher appendix (transit-ciphers.txt) that calls out minimal TLS versions we require and whether any TLS termination occurs inside the platform (we should state TLS end-to-end or internal termination points).

Place artifacts in the shared Drive folder and reply-all when uploaded. If anything needs legal or procurement signoff to release, flag now and include the expected date.

Thanks — Mina
